I used these for the first time and my heels came out so soft! The care instructions say to hand wash only and to discard after 5 months I believe so I only use one pair at a time and wash it in the sink after each use really fast. Maybe I should have bought these first instead of buying epsom soak, pedicure pumice, foot soak pan and heel balm!

reviews.t: So much better than socks for sleeping
reviews.x: The description for this cracked me up, “sewing, no lameness”. But they were exactly right, these are not lame. I hate sleeping in socks, and this came up on my feed. These are perfect, you get the freedom of wiggling toes but moisturizing heal. I used them last night and I’m ready for flip-flops this morning.  I just had a revelation, I could wear these with flip-flops around the house, keep my heels moisturized and keep my feet from hurting from walking barefoot. These are now my new favorite

reviews.t: I love all the different colors and the great moisturizing it does.
reviews.x: I liked that the moisturizing area was large so it covered around the entire heel and up in back and underneath as well. Liked that the toes were open. Material is not as soft as I thought it would be, and a tiny bit tight on my ankles.  I can leave it on for 1/2 an hour with no problem. In fact it would be fine to leave on longer, but I guess there’s a reason they limit you to 20-30 minutes 3-5 times a week.

The socks are comfortable.  The gel patch takes a bit to get used to and the socks are a lot looser than I thought they would be.  I would prefer them to be a bit tighter where I don't feel like they will fall of or down when I walk around.  But I do think they help my heals, especially when the lotion/healing cream is used in conjunction with this product.

reviews.t: Great for your heels with coconut oil
reviews.x: I love this to help with cracked heels. I use coconut oil on my heels at bedtime and these socks definitely help. I just wish they fit a little tighter so the heel section doesn’t move as much. I’m not sure yet how after washing how the rubber will hold up but for the price it’s definitely worth the money and glad I bought them.

These socks are awesome! I have eczema and these socks have made a big difference in my heels. My heels are not as cracked anymore and look and feel soft. I also like that they are open toed socks and come in different colors. My daughter tried them too and said they were comfy and her heels felt soft too.

What a GREAT DEAL!  I've been using these to prevent cracked heels for years.  In the past, they've been hard to find and very expensive when I did find them.  I was ecstatic to find this deal!  I've only been using them for a week, but they definitely meet my expectations.

This pair of socks is of good quality and material and has solved the problem of skin cracking on my feet.Before, I used a lot of skin care products, but nothing worked.With this kind of sock, the problem is well solved.Internal silicone material, no odor, very satisfied

These turned out to be so much better than others I have purchased.  They stay on your foot without being too tight.  I gave a pair to my aunt and she, in turn, bought a pack to give them to my cousins.  My husband even uses them!  Good quality!

I love these socks. I’ve had them for less than two weeks and already see and feel a tremendous improvement. I’m not that great and handwashing so I don’t know how long they will last but when they are no longer good I will reorder.

Love ‘em. They seem magical. They keep me from picking at my dry heels and heals them at the same time. I wear them around the house and while sleeping. I hand wash them (hang to dry inside out) and they are holding up well.

reviews.t: So surprised how soft these socks make my heels!
reviews.x: Love these socks! I ended up getting some for my mom and sister. You need to be consistent with wearing them every day to every other day and your feet will stay soft on the heel. I was so surprised how well they work.

Awesome products. Have been using three straight days plus using other callous remover cream and my heels are so much better. Will continue to use until I have baby soft heels which I thought would never happen!

The heel moisturizing socks are light weight, good air permeability, high elastic fabric, improve the wrapping, not easy to deform, easy to clean, very suitable for people who often stand and wear high heels

claims.text: Many reviewers say the socks effectively soften dry, cracked heels and moisturize feet.
A common complaint is that the socks are too tight, leaving marks or dents on feet and ankles.
Some reviewers report durability or quality issues, such as gel coming through the sock or bands that won't stretch.
Several reviewers find the socks comfortable and convenient, especially compared to sleeping in regular socks.
A few reviewers note the socks are thinner or less soft than expected, though some consider them good value for the price.
